notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

Added "help ghosts"
If a level is failed a certain number of times, a button prompt will be given to summon a "help ghost" to show a route through the level. This ghost is pulled from the replay data of another player

notes.title: Version 1.14e
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[list]
[*] Reworked levels 2_1 through 2_24
[*] Added a "Crouch jump" option, which allows players to choose between the default crouch-jump or a single-button jump
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused clicking off-screen to sometimes lock the game
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14d
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a keyboard option for DASH, for players who don't want to use middle mouse
[*] Added keybind options for restart and dash
[*] Added button prompts when player is using gamepad
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14c
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a "Skip Level" button to the pause menu
[*] Added the ability to remap key bindings
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.14b
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[list]
[*] Reworked levels 1_11 through 1_24
[*] Added levels 1_25 through 1_29

notes.title: Version 1.14a
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[list]
[*] Reworked levels 1_1 through 1_10 to have a less steep difficulty curve
[*] Added a NEW GAME option to the main menu to delete save data
[/list]

Leaderboard data for levels 1_1 through 1_10 will be deleted.
